name: clippy
description: A lightweight, seamless clipboard manager for macOS

scripts.start: webpack --mode development && cp src/index.html dist/ && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npx electron .
scripts.dev: webpack --mode development --watch & sleep 3 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && npx electron .
scripts.pack: webpack --mode production && cp src/index.html dist/ && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist: webpack --mode production && cp src/index.html dist/ && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && electron-builder --mac --publish never
